text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, while Satono Diamond was doing
running laps around the academy grounds...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: ...Oh my? Was there always a place like this in the academy...?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
...It's fine. As we run,
you'll start recognizing the scenery.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
...Where am I, anyway?
Looks like I'm totally lost...

...Rest assured, Satono-san.
I will show you the path you ought to take.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
McQueen-san! Thank goodness!
You can show me the way back to the academy, right?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen?
text_block_list.text: No... the path I will show you goes far beyond that!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen?
text_block_list.text:
If you follow me,
I will mold you into the strongest Umamusume.
Yes, one worthy of succeeding me—

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Huh, um... I appreciate the thought, but right now the way back to the academy—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen B
text_block_list.text:
"Do not be deceived!
Satono-san, the one you should be following is me!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen B
text_block_list.text:
A straight path down the Sweets Road to master every confection in this world!
Now, right this way!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen A
text_block_list.text:
What kind of self-indulgent nonsense are you spouting?!
Do not listen to her, Satono-san!
Following me is the only right choice!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: ...Double McQueen-san, I appreciate your kindness. However, I cannot follow either of you.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Sweets are certainly very delicious.
And McQueen-san is someone I deeply admire
and truly respect with all my heart.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
But... my wish isn't to literally become McQueen-san.
The right answer for me is—

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"To engrave my very own running style into history,
shining brighter than anyone else!"

text_block_list.name: Double McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Satono-san?!
P-Please wait—

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
...Huh.
Is this... the academy?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Satono-san.
Your Trainer was looking for you a little while ago.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, yes!
Thank you very much!"

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"...What was that place just now?
I don't know, but..."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
—I feel like I can see it much more clearly now.
The path I must take.
